Modal

A pop-up modal dialog is commonly used for message notifications and confirmations, and supports component calls ( minimum version: 25.12.0).

Sample Code

maml


<view>
  <maui-modal title='Basic Modal' content='Test Content' visible="{{currentModal === 'modal1'}}"
              primaryButtonText='Primary Button'
              bindclose='handleClose' bindprimaryButtonTap='primaryButtonTap'></maui-modal>
  <maui-modal content='Test Content (No Title)' visible="{{currentModal === 'modal2'}}" primaryButtonText='Confirm'
              bindclose='handleClose' bindprimaryButtonTap='primaryButtonTap'></maui-modal>
  <maui-modal title='Basic Modal' content='Test Content (Two Buttons Horizontal)'
              visible="{{currentModal === 'modal3'}}"
              bindclose='handleClose' bindprimaryButtonTap='primaryButtonTap' primaryButtonText='Primary Button'
              secondaryButtonText='Secondary' bindsecondaryButtonTap='secondaryButtonTap'></maui-modal>
  <maui-modal title='Basic Modal' content='Test Content (With Secondary and Cancel Buttons)'
              visible="{{currentModal === 'modal4'}}"
              primaryButtonText='Primary Button' secondaryButtonText='Secondary' cancelButtonText='Cancel'
              bindclose='handleClose'
              bindcancelButtonTap='cancelButtonTap' bindprimaryButtonTap='primaryButtonTap'
              bindsecondaryButtonTap='secondaryButtonTap'></maui-modal>

  <maui-modal title='Focus Mode' content='Test Content' visible="{{currentModal === 'modal5'}}"
              primaryButtonText='Primary Button'
              bindclose='handleClose' bindprimaryButtonTap='primaryButtonTap' type='focus'></maui-modal>
  <maui-modal title='Focus Mode' content='Test Content (Two Buttons Horizontal)' visible="{{currentModal === 'modal6'}}"
              bindclose='handleClose' bindprimaryButtonTap='primaryButtonTap' primaryButtonText='Primary Button'
              secondaryButtonText='Secondary' bindsecondaryButtonTap='secondaryButtonTap' type='focus'></maui-modal>
  <maui-modal title='Focus Mode' content='Test Content (With Secondary and Cancel Buttons)'
              visible="{{currentModal === 'modal7'}}"
              primaryButtonText='Primary Button' secondaryButtonText='Secondary' cancelButtonText='Cancel'
              bindclose='handleClose'
              bindcancelButtonTap='cancelButtonTap' bindprimaryButtonTap='primaryButtonTap'
              bindsecondaryButtonTap='secondaryButtonTap' type='focus'></maui-modal>
  <maui-modal title='Focus Mode' content='Test Content (Closable)' visible="{{currentModal === 'modal8'}}"
              primaryButtonText='Primary Button' bindclose='handleClose' bindprimaryButtonTap='primaryButtonTap'
              type='focus' closable></maui-modal>

  <maui-modal title='Custom Modal' content='DIY Primary Button' visible="{{currentModal === 'modalDIYPrimary'}}"
              primaryButtonText='Primary Button' bindclose='handleClose' bindprimaryButtonTap='primaryButtonTap'
              primaryButtonStyle='color: red'></maui-modal>
  <maui-modal title='Custom Modal' visible="{{currentModal === 'modalDIYContent'}}" primaryButtonText='Primary Button'
              bindclose='handleClose' bindprimaryButtonTap='primaryButtonTap'>
    <button>DIY Main Content as Button</button>
  </maui-modal>

  <maui-cell-group title='Basic Usage'>
    <maui-cell title='Basic Modal' bindclick='showModal' value='>' data-modal-value='modal1' />
    <maui-cell title='Alert Modal (No Title)' bindclick='showModal' value='>' data-modal-value='modal2' />
    <maui-cell title='Two-Button Modal' bindclick='showModal' value='>' data-modal-value='modal3' />
    <maui-cell title='Three-Button Modal' bindclick='showModal' value='>' data-modal-value='modal4' />
  </maui-cell-group>

  <maui-cell-group title='Focus Mode'>
    <maui-cell title='Primary Button Only' bindclick='showModal' value='>' data-modal-value='modal5' />
    <maui-cell title='With Secondary Button' bindclick='showModal' value='>' data-modal-value='modal6' />
    <maui-cell title='With Secondary and Cancel Buttons' bindclick='showModal' value='>' data-modal-value='modal7' />
    <maui-cell title='Show Close Icon' bindclick='showModal' value='>' data-modal-value='modal8' />
  </maui-cell-group>

  <maui-cell-group title='Custom Buttons'>
    <maui-cell title='DIY Primary Button' bindclick='showModal' value='>' data-modal-value='modalDIYPrimary' />
    <maui-cell title='DIY Main Content' bindclick='showModal' value='>' data-modal-value='modalDIYContent' />
  </maui-cell-group>

</view>

Page({
  data: {
    currentModal: '',
    showOverlay: false,
  },
  showModal(res) {
    this.setData({
      currentModal: res.currentTarget.dataset['modal-value'],
    });
  },
  handleClose(res) {
    this.setData({
      currentModal: '',
    });
  },

  primaryButtonTap(res) {
    this.handleClose();
    ma.showToast({
      title: 'Click on the main button',
      duration: 1000,
      mask: false,
    });
  },

  secondaryButtonTap(res) {
    this.handleClose();
    ma.showToast({
      title: 'Click the assist button',
      duration: 1000,
      mask: false,
    });
  },

  cancelButtonTap(res) {
    this.handleClose();
    ma.showToast({
      title: 'Click the cancel button',
      duration: 1000,
      mask: false,
    });
  },

  onLoad(options) {
  },
  onReady() {
  },
  onShow() {
  },
  onHide() {
  },
  onUnload() {
  },
});

{
  "navigationBarTitleText": "Modal",
  "usingComponents": {
    "maui-modal": "../../components/modal/index",
    "maui-cell-group": "../../components/cell-group/index",
    "maui-cell": "../../components/cell/index"
  }
}


button {
    margin-top: 0;
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

API

Props

Attribute Description Type Default Value
bodyClassName body class name String -
bodyStyle body style String -
cancelButtonStyle Cancel Button Style String -
cancelButtonText Cancel Button Text String/Number -
closable Whether to display the close button in the upper right corner. Only valid when type is focus Boolean -
content Content String -
destroyOnClose Whether to unload content when invisible Boolean false
maskClosable Click whether the layer triggers the bind:close. Boolean true
maskClassName Class name of the layer String -
maskStyle Mask Style String -
primaryButtonStyle Main Button Style String -
primaryButtonText Main button text String -
secondaryButtonStyle Auxiliary Button Style String -
secondaryButtonText Secondary Button Text String -
cancelButtonColor Cancel Button Font Color String -
title Title String -
type Type, optional: default (default) or focus (emphasis mode) String default
visible Whether to display Boolean -

Events

Event Name Description
bind:cancelButtonTap Cancel button click event
bind:close Click the close button in the upper right corner in the layer or emphasis mode to trigger the callback
bind:primaryButtonTap Main button click event
bind:secondaryButtonTap Secondary button click event

Slot

Name Description
- Custom content
